description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
